name: TwoPrimaryQuotient.halving_abscissa_identity
statement: theorem halving_abscissa_identity {R : Type} [CommRing R] (x a b X : R) : (3*x^2+a)^2-4*(x^3+a*x+b)*(2*x+X) = x^4-4*X*x^3-2*a*x^2-(8*b+4*a*X)*x+a^2-4*b*X

name: TwoPrimaryQuotient.quotient_lift_independent
statement: theorem quotient_lift_independent {B A C : Type} [IntModule B] [IntModule A] [IntModule C] (k : B → A) (l : B → C) (ks : ∀ b c, k (b-c)=k b-k c) (ls : ∀ b c, l (b-c)=l b-l c) (included : ∀ b, k b=0 → l b=0) (b c : B) (same : k b=k c) : l b=l c

name: TwoPrimaryQuotient.four_classes_have_sixteen_lifts
statement: theorem four_classes_have_sixteen_lifts {B A : Type} [IntModule B] [IntModule A] (k : B → A) (h : A → B) (surjective : ∀ a, ∃ b, k b=a) (hz : h 0=0) (linear : ∀ n : Int, ∀ a, h (n • a)=n • h a) (norm : ∀ b, h (k b)=(4 : Int) • b) (a : A) (ha : (4 : Int) • a=0) : ∃ b, k b=a ∧ (16 : Int) • b=0

name: TwoPrimaryQuotient.frobenius_twelve_mod_sixteen
statement: theorem frobenius_twelve_mod_sixteen {R : Type} [CommRing R] (x : R) (h16 : (16 : R)=0) (hx : x^2+7*x+101=0 ∨ x^2+11*x+101=0) : x^12=1

name: TwoPrimaryQuotient.reverse_cross_degree_four
statement: theorem reverse_cross_degree_four (n r s u v : Nat) (hn : 0<n) (hr : n=r*u) (hs : n=s*v) (degree : 4*n=r*s) : n=4*(u*v)

name: TwoPrimaryQuotient.integer_cleared_maps_vanish_on_four
statement: theorem integer_cleared_maps_vanish_on_four {A C : Type} [IntModule A] [IntModule C] (f l : A → C) (fz : f 0=0) (linear : ∀ n : Int, ∀ a, f (n • a)=n • f a) (cleared : ∀ a, l a=(4 : Int) • f a) (a : A) (ha : (4 : Int) • a=0) : ∀ n : Int, n • l a=0
